question: Should this PR establish medium-weight tokens as the default for non-prominent iOS controls after the shared-chat audit bug is fixed?
rationale: Automated review can identify the test-coverage bug, but the visible hierarchy policy and protected maintainer label require human design intent before merge.

options.title: Fix Audit And Accept Policy
options.body: Preserve the shared iOS audit coverage, then merge if maintainers want medium-weight defaults for non-prominent iOS controls.

options.title: Narrow To Code Polish
options.body: Keep the targeted token demotions but remove or soften the AGENTS.md and DESIGN.md policy language.

options.title: Hold For Design Review
options.body: Pause until an iOS owner supplies the preferred token hierarchy or alternate visual treatment.

recommendation.title: Fix Audit And Accept Policy
recommendation.body: Preserve the shared iOS audit coverage, then merge if maintainers want medium-weight defaults for non-prominent iOS controls.
